mentions.name: Muro
mentions.description: This app allocates focus hours based on the user's calendar, so they can see at the start of each day when they can block out time for deep, heads-down focus work.
mentions.problem: Hard to know from a calendar when uninterrupted focus time is available during the day.
mentions.source_excerpt: Muro allocates focus hours based on your calendar. It helps me know at the start of my day, when I can put my head down and focus.

evidence.value: Muro allocates focus hours based on your calendar. It helps me know at the start of my day, when I can put my head down and focus.
evidence.author: bonniesimon

mentions.name: Muro
mentions.description: Muro is a focus-time finder that connects to multiple calendars and identifies when the user can work uninterrupted, removing the overhead of manually planning around a busy meeting schedule.
mentions.problem: As an engineer, it is hard to know when you can put your head down and work when you have multiple meetings, creating overhead in planning your morning.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Muro (getmuro.com). Connect your calendar (multiple calendars) and then see muro find you focus times.

evidence.value: I'm building Muro (getmuro.com). Connect your calendar (multiple calendars) and then see muro find you focus times.
evidence.author: bonniesimon

mentions.name: getmuro.com
mentions.description: A scheduling tool that connects to the user's calendars and surfaces open time slots for focused, heads-down work between meetings and calls.
mentions.problem: People juggling multiple calendars and many daily calls struggle to find uninterrupted time to focus.
mentions.audience: People who manage multiple calendars and multiple calls per day.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on getmuro.com

It takes in your calendars and gives you time slots where you can put your head down and work! It built it for myself, but a few people found it interesting, so I thought of publishing it.
